snippet.title: FEED IT - Official Reveal Trailer
snippet.description:
A first-person, PSX-style horror game about living with a monster. Do as you're told... or don't. Just be ready for the consequences.

Wishlist FEED IT on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4370990/FEED_IT/

FEED IT is a short-form horror experience featuring multiple paths to completion, secret endings and a constant choice you'll have to face right from the start.

#feedit  #indiehorror #psxhorror #firstpersonhorror #horrorgame
